snippet.title: Fruitbearer Trailer - DEMO coming out soon | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4300180/Fruitbearer/

Making a darker, edgier, less casual Suika-style roguelike deckbuilder called Fruitbearer!

If you like the look of it, please give us a wishlist on Steam. It helps a ton!

Also, feel free to comment and let us know what you think of the game! :D
